name: 推特运营方法论
tagline: A daily posting system for X: ideas, drafts, timing and review
description: It sets up the machinery behind posting every day: a standing bank of subjects to draw from, a read on what is performing in your corner of the platform, drafts written to be pasted out as they are, sensible hours to send them, and a look back at what worked. Move accounts and it comes with you.
author: KinGao476942
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
